result.instructions:
golauncher is the user's keyboard launcher for Windows. Its plugins (apps, files, WinGet and Scoop packages, network tools, system commands, clipboard history when the user allows it, and more) are available through these tools:
1. list_plugins shows the plugins you may use and their commands; search finds items (apps, commands, results of plugins) by words, like typing in the launcher.
2. run_command runs a plugin command (e.g. one that opens a list such as a package search), optionally with arguments and a search query; its items come back with handles.
3. get_detail reads an item's details; run_action runs one of an item's actions (the first is the default). Use only handles returned by these tools; they expire after 10 minutes.
Every item lists its actions with a risk: "read" runs directly; "open" (open an app, a URL, a folder, copy text) usually runs directly; "change" and "destructive" ask the user to confirm in the launcher window first. If the user declines, do not retry or work around it; tell the user instead. Report only what the tool results say was done.

tools.name: list_plugins
tools.title: List plugins
tools.description: List the launcher plugins you may use, with their commands (name, title, whether it opens a list or acts at once, its arguments and risk). Pass plugin to list one plugin only.

tools.name: search
tools.title: Search the launcher
tools.description: Search the launcher's root search (apps, commands and plugin results), or, with view, the list returned by run_command or run_action. Returns items with handles and their actions.

plugin.description: Only items of this plugin ID

view.description: A view handle (v…) to search in instead of the root search

tools.name: run_command
tools.title: Run a launcher command
tools.description: Run a plugin command from list_plugins. A command that opens a list returns its items (filtered by query when given); a command that acts at once asks the user to confirm first.

query.description: Search text typed into the opened list

tools.name: get_detail
tools.title: Read an item's details
tools.description: Read the details (text and metadata) of an item by its handle.

tools.name: run_action
tools.title: Run an item's action
tools.description: Run an action of an item (by its handle; the first action when action is omitted), or submit a form (f… handle) with values. Actions that change something ask the user to confirm first; the result says whether it was done or declined.

handle.description: An item handle (i…) or a form handle (f…)

action.description: The action ID (default: the first action)

values.description: Form field values by field ID, or the item's argument values by name (checkbox: "true"/"false", date: YYYY-MM-DD, dropdown: the option value)
